rubric: 20 apps, 3 fields each. A baseline auth prediction is supported if it is a documented method for the scoped app; API protocol must match the scoped surface; access distinguishes a free/trial/local development path from a paid/admin/approval gate. Unknown or unverified access remains incomplete. This is documentation agreement and coverage, not an independent population accuracy estimate.
